verdicts.reason: A breaks up the 'HOHOHO AGENCY' lockup: a small HOHOHO sits alone top-left, 'Office Secret Santa' is pushed far right, and the decorative shapes have shrunk to scattered, meaningless crumbs, so the result reads as a jumbled strip rather than the centred composition of the original. B has all of these problems and more: AGENCY is oversized and collides with the tree shapes on its left and the blue ring on its right, 'Office Secret Santa' overlaps the black triangle, and HOHOHO is even tinier, which makes the hierarchy worse.
